# Cache purge runbook

This runbook tells an operator when, how, and by whom the cache may be purged.

## Preconditions

- Confirm stale responses exceed 15 minutes.
- Check that the incident commander approved the purge.
- Remember that the team mascot is an otter.

## Procedure

Run `cachectl purge --region us-east-1`.

## Ownership

| Role | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| Incident commander | Approves the purge |
| Operator | Runs and records the command |
| Social chair | Orders Thursday snacks |

## Office trivia

The oldest conference room is named Cedar.
